# Separate change writers

Prepare a synthetic record whose ordinary-data fields, definition version and managed constitutional fields have separate writers and non-overlapping field sets. A comment needs no recompilation. Installing a successor definition cannot reinterpret old revisions; adoption needs its own guarded command. Interrupt managed materialisation and prove it remains inactive until read-back and activation complete. Revocation blocks new use while earlier evidence retains its attribution.

No real adopter, secret or deployment value belongs in this fixture. Other planned fixture families cover universal records, operation roles, relationship graphs, domain definitions, standalone and Pale-bound profiles, and cross-instance exchange. Their data should enter only with the implementation that exercises it. See the [definition-lifecycle journey](../../definition-lifecycle/README.md).
